DeepSeek Harness Will v0.1.3 adopts the bilingual application name Deepseek Harness Will — 组装未来 across Windows and macOS while retaining the established repository and artifact names.

Highlights:
- The installed application, window, tray, notification, and shortcut name is Deepseek Harness Will — 组装未来.
- Existing installed and portable data directories remain compatible across the name change.
- Apple Silicon (arm64) and Intel (x64) DMGs for macOS 12 or later.
- Native macOS traffic-light window controls, template tray icon, and persistent login-shell terminal.
- Architecture-matched, checksum-verified Node/npm runtime in every Windows and macOS package.
- One release workflow that builds, smoke-tests, and publishes all supported platforms together.
- Expanded English and Chinese README with installation, usage, and real input/output examples.

Current features include 10 optional UI skins, DeepSeek balance display, soul.md editing, plugin management, persistent terminal sessions, agent update/rollback, close-to-tray behavior, task notifications, and the official Harness model/MCP/session/file-diff UI.

The packages are currently unsigned. Windows may show SmartScreen, and macOS may require Control-click → Open after the download is verified. macOS client updates are manual from GitHub Releases; Windows retains consent-gated client updates.
